title: Feels — Teaching a Robot to Feel

chapters.name: What is in the cup?
chapters.narration: What is in the cup? This robot cannot see inside it — and it does not need to.

chapters.name: The swirl is the sensor
chapters.narration: Feels teaches a robot to feel. The arm picks up a sealed, lidded cup, swirls it, and reads the joint torques.

chapters.name: Reading the spectrum
chapters.narration: The same signature drives a state spectrum, with the nearest neighbors from the Atlas vector library. Loadedness and rigidity, read at a glance. The neighbors are all water — the mystery cup reads as water, at point nine cosine similarity.

chapters.name: The numbers
